Under its real embedding A lies in R, whereas the other two roots of t^3-2 are nonreal, so A/Q is not normal and is not Galois. This supplies a connected non-Galois finite étale example with empty boundary. It does not prove or disprove the cited 7.1/10.1 proofs, and no theorem of tame ramification or Lefschetz theorem was checked.
